selected_grasp_id.description: Best physically valid and safe grasp. Null if none are safe.

scores.description: Scores for the selected grasp only. Null if no grasp is selected.

safety_reason.description: Short explanation (1–2 sentences) of why the grasp is safe or unsafe (e.g., avoids breaking risk, does not disturb other objects, maintains stable control). Null if no grasp is selected.
